posts.name: EvilWayne
posts.cooked:
Is there any chance the storage box will accommodate sleeved cards and still fit everything published?

I sleeve my SotM cards in mix of Mayday and FFG sleeves, but I’m slowly converting them all over to FFG (because, well, cha-ching!). They look nicer and will hold up longer. Currently the boxes do not hold the cards as they are meant to be stored. The FFG sleeved cards have to be store sideways and they don’t all fit at the moment. It’d be super-swell if the case had ample room for sleeved cards.

Just curious...
